data.body: **P2 — Make close gating atomic with continuation failure selection.** `close()` can set `closing` after this `!isClosing()` check but before `signalContinuationFailure`, causing an ordinary cleanup failure to invoke `stopAllOperations` and wake unrelated operations despite the normal-close guarantee. Select the failure under the same coordination state transition as `closing`, stopping operations only when that atomic selection wins; apply the same fix to the coordinator-rejection path and add a barrier-based race test.
